summary: Weekly upkeep scan over main at 74dade51: all three detectors ran. One flaky test seen failing then passing on the same tree in two runs, one Go toolchain pinned to two versions, and one deprecated stdlib package still in use. Three issues proposed.

evidence.detail: verify failed on TestWidgetSync, then passed on the retry with no tree change
same failure signature on an unrelated diff

proposed_issue.title: Quarantine flaky test TestWidgetSync
proposed_issue.body: TestWidgetSync failed and then passed on the same tree in two runs this week. Quarantine it and fix the ordering assumption it races on.

proposed_issue.title: Align the drifting Go toolchain pins
proposed_issue.body: go.work pins Go 1.25.0 while backend/Dockerfile builds on golang:1.24. Pick one version and pin both.

evidence.detail: io/ioutil is deprecated since Go 1.16; use os.ReadFile

proposed_issue.title: Replace deprecated io/ioutil calls
proposed_issue.body: backend/internal/legacy/load.go still calls ioutil.ReadFile. Replace it with os.ReadFile.
